description.value:
Charging the air itself, you conjure a patch of Force-fed flame on ground you can see within range, filling a 5-foot cube for the duration. Any creature occupying that space when the fire appears must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 1d8 energy damage; the save is repeated whenever a creature enters the space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

The flames ignite unattended flammable objects within the area.

Damage rises to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.
